title: Disability Certificate
content: Persons with disabilities can apply for a Disability Certificate through the UDID system. The application is assessed by authorized medical authorities or medical boards.

title: Disability Certificate
content: A person can register on the UDID portal and apply for a Disability Certificate and UDID card. The application is processed by the concerned medical authority or medical board.

title: Disability Certificate
content: The concerned medical authorities verify the application and conduct disability assessment according to the applicable disability assessment guidelines.

title: Disability Certificate
content: The UDID system supports online application, tracking, renewal and updating of disability-related information.
